pages.title: The Puppet Company Chameleon Large Hand Puppet
pages.description: A 56cm long Chameleon Hand Puppet that is absolutely stunning with beautiful printed designs. Ideal for children with loads of imagination who like puppets. 2 years+
pages.ld_description: To all creepy crawlies fans! This colourful Rainbow Chameleon Puppet is full of personality, with vibrant printed fabrics and excellent mouth and tongue movement. Easy to manipulate and suitable for both children and adults, it’s ideal for imaginative play, storytelling and exploring the natural world. Size: 17cm (L) × 22cm (W) × 20cm (H). 1 year and older.
